markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn

The conformal set holds only Normal, the image is typical, and both cross-checks agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, InSitu 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.97 / 8th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Fully consistent |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Prominent benign stroma; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Scored high, but spot check failed (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 5) · context · Scored below typical; spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Nuclei counts** (regions 6, 8, 11) · context · 1 neoplastic of 21 nuclei; too few for cell features · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect is +0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier; normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration is coarse: ECE 0.05, CI up to 0.18, on a small test set.
- Cell sample covers only 3 of 12 regions; focal tumor in others would go uncounted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 10**: confirm benign fibrous stroma or fat, with no atypical epithelium.
2. **Regions 3, 7, 9**: verify normal lobules directly; the AI spot check failed (0/20).
3. **Region 6**: top region for infiltrating-stroma score and holds the only neoplastic nucleus; confirm it is benign.
